findings.statement: For T10 at your hardcore-survivability goal, EHP is 40000 against a 67200 target — building toward that number is what unlocks the tier safely.

fixTemplates.label: Add effective HP
fixTemplates.hint: More life/ES, or a mitigation layer (armour, evasion, block), raises EHP fastest.

findings.statement: T10 is a reach right now — the limiters are DOC-2, DOC-3, DOC-4. Clear those and your ceiling rises fast.

findings.statement: Chaos resistance is at 10%; lifting it about 15% toward 25% removes one of the most common "died at full health" causes for your goal.

fixTemplates.label: Pick up chaos resistance
fixTemplates.hint: Chaos res is gear-only in PoE2 — target it on rings, amulet, or a corrupted implicit.

findings.statement: Locking down stun avoidance sits at 40% (target 100%) keeps you in control when a fight turns dangerous — that's a big smoothness-and-safety win for hardcore-survivability.

fixTemplates.label: Add stun/ailment protection
fixTemplates.hint: Stun threshold, freeze/shock/ignite avoidance on gear, or an ailment-immunity flask/charm.

findings.statement: Your elemental resistances are capped with no overcap to reclaim — nicely balanced.
Your defensive layers back each other up — no obvious single-point-of-failure in the mitigation stack.
Your recovery outpaces the damage you take between packs — sustain is holding up for this goal.
Your 1600000 DPS is enough to clear T10 at your hardcore-survivability pace — no need to chase overkill damage; spend elsewhere.
Every socketed skill is affordable to cast and the engine raised no cost warnings — nothing dead weight here.
